# ADF

`jmfsb_faction_adf`

2040 ADF: ADF Re-Cut's Modern-era Australian Defence Force - its AMCU soldiers, Commandos, Recon and SASR, its armour, cars, trucks, helicopters, C-130s and statics - with the base game's NATO jets, AA, artillery, boats and drones in the gaps. Generated by `tools/gen_mod_factions.py`.
